<thought>Now that we know the valid functional group names, I will search for templates that break an alkyl halide (C‑Cl bond) and form a primary amine (C‑N bond), matching the described SN2 transformation.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["alkyl halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["primary amines"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-Cl"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-N"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
